verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a customer data platform, but the evidence pack shows no first-party natural-language command interface or assistant for operating Segment. The "Open in ChatGPT/Claude" links on docs pages only hand documentation to external chatbots, and "AI-powered audiences" is a marketing phrase with no documented natural-language control. The Public API is a programmatic building block, not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
